analysis: The change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is documentation only: a date bump at line 3 and a new `darkbloom status` bullet at head lines 990-1001. The bullet describes a 'Requests served since the daemon started' counter. It covers output tokens only, resets on daemon restart or when a scheduled window opens, and includes early-ended requests and free self-route requests. It points to the platform's heartbeat.go `cumulativeDelta` through an immutable commit link, plus `StatusCommand+ServedRequests.swift`. The edit adds no code, config, endpoint, key handling or authorization change. The text does not show the counter carrying prompt or completion content, only counts and tokens, so A-001 is not newly exposed. It does not change attestation, App Attest authorization, the TB-002 WebSocket contract, logout/revocation semantics, or the prefix-cache posture (T-041). The status counter is local and operator-visible. Provider-reported counters are self-reported and untrusted by the coordinator, and the doc says paid jobs are on the console Earnings page, so it makes no billing-authority claim. Unverified here: whether the referenced StatusCommand+ServedRequests.swift and the coordinator heartbeat counter exist and behave as described. They are outside the supplied evidence and the claim is documentation-only, so this is not a finding. The other changed lines reviewed (398-1297) are unchanged surrounding documentation and show no new security regressions.
